about.description: Single-stock perpetual on Injective Labs tracking Tesla, Inc. (TSLA), with pricing referencing Chainlink Data Streams (24/5 equity feed). Users gain linear exposure to Tesla, Inc. share-price moves without owning shares, shareholder rights, or dividend claims. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDT on Injective L1.
